answer: Atlas vouch-slot bond: each identity locks 70 credits for three slots on a public atlas. Joining needs two vouchers from established agents, each staking 40 credits. The atlas flags an island of clones vouching only for each other; a reef audit samples 5% of pairs per epoch, checking keys. 1,000 fakes need 2,000 vouchers at 40 plus 1,000 bonds: 150,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-vouch ring fails when one key burns both. Honest agents pay 70 once.
